text.en:
The minimum basic salary of the lowest level of teaching position shall be increased from P666 to
P904 per month inclusive of the P130 per month allowances.

Other teaching positions whose salaries are beyond the minimum basic salary shall be correspondingly
increased, following the salary progression under the Teacher's Preparation Pay Schedule.

Funds needed to implement this Order shall be drawn from the salary lapses of the MEC, and the
Salary Adjustment Fund in the CY 1981 Appropriations Act and budgetary reserves.

Rules and regulations needed to comply with this Order shall be formulated and issued by the Ministry
of the Budget.

This Executive Order shall take effect on July, 1, 1981.
